description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeePunchInOutMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface to configure menu items related to employee punch-in/out functionality within the Attendance module of the OrangeHRM system. It uses traits and references external entities like Screen and MenuItem to override module and screen settings for the UI.

classes.name: EmployeePunchInOutMenuConfigurator
classes.description: This class implements the MenuConfigurator interface and provides an override configuration for the attendance menu, setting the module to 'time' and the screen to 'viewAttendanceRecord'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the menu configuration to set the current module to 'time' and the screen to 'viewAttendanceRecord'.
